messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated queue latency observed on hosted/inference-prod (rule infra.inference.queue_latency > 500ms for 5m). Severity P2. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra-inference-queue. Pager: @alice_oncall :pager:

alice_oncall: on it, paging @maria @alan. Starting triage.

maria: I’m pulling traces and checking pool util + autoscaler logs. Will look at region distribution first.

alan: joining. Quick glance — large burst from ap-southeast-2, autoscaler ramp lagged, queue grew. KV cache miss rate up ~3x.

alice_oncall: Mitigations plan (short): 1) enable cluster-level burst_capacity_override on cluster-A; 2) reduce max_batch_size -> 16 for small-seq jobs; 3) route non-SLA traffic to eu-west fallback. Applying #1 now.

maria: running: `curl -s http://metrics/api/queries?name=inference.queue_size | jq '.[0].value'` -> `4200` (peak). Also `kubectl -n inference get hpa` shows scale target not increased for 7m.

alan: applied burst override on cluster-A (`rbac:write`), reduced batch size on inference-deployments in ap-south and ap-se2. Starting gradual 20% reroute to eu-west via traffic-router.

support: Heads up — top 3 paying customers show increased p99 and queued requests. Do we have a status page copy to post?

maria: Draft status page copy: "We are investigating increased latency affecting hosted inference in APAC. We have applied mitigation steps (burst override, reduced batching, partial reroute). Some customers may experience slower responses. No data loss. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or as new info is available." OK to post?

product: Add an ETA and a quick remediation recommendation: recommend affected customers consider using Redwood Dedicated or limited-rate fallback until we fully recover. Also note expected recovery window.

alice_oncall: Observed queue drop from 4200 -> 900 after burst override + batch change (6 minutes). KV cache miss spikes still present but trending down. ETA to baseline ~20-30 minutes if trend holds. Posting status now.

support: I’ll send customer-facing email to the affected accounts with the drafted copy and ETA. Will cc eng-contacts.

maria: Follow-ups we need to track: tune autoscaler ramp for region bursts; add surge-detector alert scoped to per-region queue growth; consider per-customer shed policy to protect SLAs. I’ll open RFC after the incident.

incident-bot: NOTE: incident channel #incident-5150001234 created. Severity set P2. Pager duty acknowledged by alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: update: 95th latency and queue size trending toward normal, monitoring for 30m. Marking mitigation successful for now. Will close after stable window unless we see regression. :white_check_mark:
